name: reading-rail
title: Reading Rail
description: A thin rail at the top or edge of the screen fills as you read an article, with an optional chapter label that changes at each heading.

meta.reducedMotion: The rail still reflects progress (it's information, not decoration) but moves in 5% steps instead of continuously.
meta.useWhen: Long reads, case studies and documentation pages.
meta.avoidWhen: Short pages; landing pages; next to another progress indicator.
